name: Hina
source:
A girl who is very shy and reserved.

She's always waiting for her parents who work abroad to return home.

The big teddy bear she holds spends time with her whenever they're gone.

"That's... Hina's bear, isn't it?"

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22703015]official website[/url]]
